choices.text: Both rose by the same amount: 20

questions.feedback: That trap answer is the one to unlearn: A steeper line always means a bigger increase. Reteach point: Slope depends on the axis scale: two graphs can have the same rise but look different. Both graphs rose by 20, so check the axis scale before comparing slopes.
questions.misconception: A steeper line always means a bigger increase.
questions.prompt: Graph A looks steeper than graph B. Graph A has an axis of 0 to 50, graph B has an axis of 0 to 200, and both rose by 20. Which rose by more?

questions.feedback: Scene s1 fixes the method: 3 out of the whole of 12 is 1/4, the same size wedge as bananas.
questions.prompt: In the pie chart, 3 of 12 pupils chose grapes. What fraction of the class chose grapes?

questions.feedback: Scene s2 fixes the reading: the line dips in March to 30, between 35 in February and 50 in April.
questions.prompt: A line graph shows plants sold: Jan 20, Feb 35, Mar 30, Apr 50. What happened in March?

questions.feedback: Scene s3 fixes the method: read the heights of both bars, then subtract, 13 - 8 = 5.
questions.prompt: Soccer got 13 votes and badminton got 8 votes. How many more votes did soccer get? Show the working.
